Startling news coming out of the Lone Star State.
**
HEADLINE:POLLS TIGHTEN IN TEXAS**

---
**
We did not sleep last night ....** liberal darling and poster boy for the far-left, Beto O'Rourke just launched a new offensive in his campaign to flip Texas BLUE.

**_FIRST:_**
The Democrats rallied to Beto's defense and anointed him as their best hope to flip Texas blue and ensure Republicans can never win again.

name: Tom Fitton
subject: What is Biden Hiding?!
body:
Soros Update!

[INSIDE JW]

What is Biden Hiding?

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60277&L=28072&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly95b3V0dS5iZS9wVlhyZVdMQlAxWT91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=]

President Biden tucked away more than 1,850 boxes of archival records
from his 36-year Senate career at the University of Delaware. Of
course, Biden and the university don’t want anyone to see them.

Here’s the latest. The Delaware Superior Court ordered
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60277&L=28067&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtdS1kZWwtYmlkZW4tZG9jcy1vcmRlci0wMDEvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==]
the university to respond to our objections to its response justifying
its decision to restrict access to the records.

Reviewing an affidavit submitted by the university, and Judicial Watch
and the Daily Caller News Foundation’s objections
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60277&L=28068&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtdS1kZWwtYmlkZW4tZG9jcy1vYmplY3Rpb24tMDAxLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=]
to it, Judge Mary M. Johnston on August 23 gave the University 30 days
to respond.

In June the court had ordered
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60277&L=27486&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvc2VuYXRlLWJpZGVuLWRvY3VtZW50cy8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE]
the university
to provide under oath additional information on its decision, in which
the university asserted that no state funds were used on the
university’s “matters or undertakings” regarding Biden and that
the Biden Senate papers were never discussed at any meetings of the
university’s full Board of Trustees.

This began when, with the Daily Caller News Foundation, we filed
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60277&L=26437&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvanctc3Vlcy11ZGVsYXdhcmUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==]
a July 2020
Delaware Freedom of Information Act lawsuit after the university
denied our requests on April 30, 2020, for all of Biden’s Senate
records and records about the preservation and any proposed release of
the records, including communications with Biden or his
representatives (_Judicial Watch, Inc. v. University of Delaware_
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60277&L=19545&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p1ZGljaWFsLXdhdGNoLXYtZGVsYXdhcmUtZG9qLXUtb2YtZGVsYXdhcmUvXV8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE,
_No. N20A-07-001 MMJ (Del. Super.)).

In February of 2021, we appealed
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60277&L=27485&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvanctZGMtYmlkZW4tcmVjb3Jkcy8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE]
an adverse lower
court ruling, and the Delaware Supreme Court returned
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60277&L=26465&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvanctZGVsYXdhcmUtc2NvdHVzLWJpZGVuLXNlbmF0ZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE]
the
case to the lower court.

The university then filed an affidavit, citing no documents or other
specifics, stating that no state funds were used in its housing of
Biden’s Senate papers and that the papers were never discussed at
any meetings of the university’s full Board of Trustees.

We argue that the supplemental affidavit submitted by the university

Hi Peter,Our team has had a busy week on the campaign trail. I wanted to provide you with an update on Bryan's campaign and give you a heads up about a few upcoming events, including the Grand Opening of the Kenosha GOP office, Super Saturday, and Fall Fest.**New TV Ad Launched** Bryan launched his first TV ad for the 2022 election. If you haven't seen it yet, you can click the image below or watch it [**here.**](https://email.rally.digital/t/j-l-vidkyty-idtjvlhlh-r/) [](https://email.rally.digital/t/j-l-vidkyty-idtjvlhlh-y/) **Steil Signs **This past week our team has worked to put up our big signs across the district. We are working to get up more. If you know of a good location for a field sign, 3x4, or if you would like a yard sign, please let us know! **Kenosha Office Grand Opening **Tomorrow, the Kenosha County GOP and Congressman Bryan Steil will be opening up a Victory Center office in Kenosha. The Grand Opening is at noon. We hope to see you tomorrow at 5901 75th Street, Suite 140. **Super Saturdays - Get out the Vote! **Team Steil is encouraging volunteers to attend one of the many Super Saturdays occurring in the First Congressional District this weekend. You can help flip Wisconsin Red by knocking on doors and encouraging folks to vote for Steil, Johnson, Michels, and other conservative candidates this fall. A list can be found here below: __Kenosha:__ 17th 5901 S. 75th St. - 9:30 AM __Mount Pleasant:__ 6100 W. Washington St. - 9:00 AM __Franklin:__ 7174 S. 76th St. - 9:30 AM __Whitewater:__ 130 Center St - 9:00 AM __Delavan__ : Scarecrow Fest, Launch from GOP Booth - 8:30 AM __Janesville:__ Home Depot Parking Lot - 9:30 AM _For more information, please contact Tyler Murray at[ tmurray@wisgop.info](mailto:tmurray@wisgop.info). _**Last Weekend **Last weekend, Bryan stopped in Whitewater for the UW-W game. The Warhawks won in a thriller. As you know, the City of Whitewater is now included in the First Congressional District. Bryan also stopped at Corn Fest in Darien before heading to D.C. for votes this week. Team Steil is looking forward to another action-packed weekend. Interested in volunteering? Please let us know by emailing us or by visiting Bryan's campaign website **[here](https://email.rally.digital/t/j-l-vidkyty-idtjvlhlh-j/)[.](https://email.rally.digital/t/j-l-vidkyty-idtjvlhlh-t/)****Fall Fest Next Weekend! **First District Fall Fest is next weekend. Join Bryan, Tim Michels, and other Republican candidates for a rally in Union Grove at the Racine County Fairgrounds. The event kicks off at noon. We hope to see you there! More information can be found **[here.](https://email.rally.digital/t/j-l-vidkyty-idtjvlhlh-i/)** Thank you,James

name: John Gomez  - Campaign Manager
subject: Chabot for Congress - Update from the Campaign Trail 9/16
body:
Warren County FOP Endorsement, Festivals, out-of-control inflation, and more!
No images? [Click here](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-e-tjluirx-kujkulhluu-o/) [](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjluirx-kujkulhluu-r/)
# Update from the Campaign Trail 9/16/22
Good evening,Team Chabot has been working harder than ever to make sure our message reaches every corner of the district. Congressman Chabot has been knocking doors and attending events throughout Ohio's First Congressional District. Support continues to roll in from throughout the district; momentum is certainly on our side. Read on for these updates and more updates from the trail! **_Congressman Chabot on the Trail_** _Congressman Chabot and Team Knocking Doors_ Congressman Chabot has been consistently knocking doors throughout the district. This past weekend, Congressman Chabot knocked doors in Hamilton Township and Maineville to very positive responses. Meanwhile, other members of Team Chabot knocked doors throughout the district, making sure voters know Congressman Chabot is fighting for them while Greg Landsman is fighting for Nancy Pelosi's agenda. _Church Festivals_ This week, Congressman Chabot attended several church festivals throughout Ohio's First Congressional District. Congressman Chabot attended festivals at St. Clement in St. Bernard, St. Savior in Deer Park, and St. Susanna in Mason. It was great to see so many friends, new and old, at all of these events. Congressman Chabot even ran into Bill Cunningham at the St. Savior Festival in Deer Park! _Hamilton County Police Association 1st Annual Cigars, Bourbon, and Badges Fundraiser_ _ _ This week, Congressman Chabot attended the 1st Annual Hamilton County Police Association Cigars, Bourbon, and Badges Fundraiser. We are more than happy to support the men and women who sacrifice so much to keep our communities safe. Overall, it was a fantastic event! **_New Release - Warren County FOP Endorse Congressman Steve Chabot for Reelection_** _Local Law Enforcement Continue to Rally Behind Chabot 's Campaign Against Extreme Candidate Who Wrote Proposal to Defund the Police_CINCINNATI - Congressman Steve Chabot's campaign released the following statement on receiving a unanimous endorsement for reelection from the Warren County Fraternal Order of Police on Wednesday."I'm incredibly humbled to have the endorsement and support of the men and women who serve to keep Warren County communities safe." Congressman Steve Chabot said. "I'm proud of my record of delivering results for our first responders and police, supporting safer communities and fighting back against extreme voices who try to vilify law enforcement.""I'm thankful to the Warren County Fraternal Order of Police and the Cincinnati Fraternal Order of Police for supporting my campaign for reelection," Chabot continued. "I look forward to continuing to stand with law enforcement and ensure they have the support, training, equipment and respect they need to keep southwest Ohio families safe.""My campaign's growing support from the law enforcement community highlights the contrast between my record and that of my opponent," Chabot said. "While I've always supported those who serve to keep us safe, Greg Landsman sided with the most radical elements of his party by voting to strip a million dollars from law enforcement and introducing a plan to defund the Cincinnati police -- even as Cincinnati faced rising crime and more murders. Ohio families simply cannot trust Landsman to keep our communities safe." **_Volunteer and Join Team Chabot Today!_** Chabot for Congress is always welcoming volunteers to help bring us across the finish line this fall. There are plenty of ways to volunteer, including helping us deliver yard signs, knocking doors, and making phone calls. For more information visit our site at the link [here ](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjluirx-kujkulhluu-y/)or email our Political Director Jason Sponaugle at jsponaugle@stevechabot.com. _This Week 's Blog - "Inflation, Inflation, Inflation_ _"_ This week's blog post is about the devastating effects of inflation and the role it will play in this fall's elections _" In this important 2022 election cycle, I'd have to say that inflation is likely to play that role, and be on the minds of many voters as they cast their ballots. And Democrats' policies are directly responsible for the fact that we're seeing inflation rates at 40 year highs. And unfortunately people across-the-board are being hurt by those policies, and the resulting high cost of virtually everything."_Read the blog post [here](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjluirx-kujkulhluu-j/). Have a great weekend.Yours truly,John GomezCampaign Manager - Chabot for Congress [Donate](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjluirx-kujkulhluu-t/) [Get a Yard Sign](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjluirx-kujkulhluu-i/) [](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjluirx-kujkulhluu-d/) [](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjluirx-kujkulhluu-h/)[](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjluirx-kujkulhluu-k/)[](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjluirx-kujkulhluu-u/) [ Share ](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-fb-tjluirx-kujkulhluu-b/) [ Tweet ](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-tw-tjluirx-kujkulhluu-n/) [ Forward ](https://stevechabotforcongress.forwardtomyfriend.com/r-kujkulhluu-961825B2-tjluirx-l-p) | Chabot for Congress, P.O. | | | Peter,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $25 makes a difference. $25 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61311019:Jfw6aDVNJ:m:1:3331421248:E587D563EDB608EDF07ED262BAC6098C:r "Johnson1")**_

Please, Peter, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

name: Al Franken
subject: the next Senator Franken
body:
Hello People of the World,
It’s me – Al Franken! – interrupting your inbox to hit you up for a donation to help elect Senator Franken.
Just to be clear: I’m not running for Senate (not right now anyway).
No. I’m emailing you about Admiral Mike Franken, the Democrat running for Senate in Iowa against the spineless fossil known as Chuck Grassley.
As far as we can tell, Mike and I are not related. But we’ve got a whole lot else in common.
He’s a retired three-star Admiral who commanded destroyers, fought pirates, and oversaw covert ops in the U.S. Navy.
Okay. I did none of that.
But I’m a comedy writer who wrote books about Republicans who don’t tell the truth. And I remember back in 2009, after we Democrats in the Senate had introduced the Affordable Care Act, Chuck Grassley flat out lied about it. He said, referring to the so-called “death panels” that the ACA would determine “when you pulled the plug on grandma.”
Grassley had to walk that back. But then he voted against the ACA. And did so repeatedly, year after year. But finally, after learning that Americans and Iowans overwhelmingly like the health care coverage they get under the Affordable Care Act, Grassley has pledged NOT to vote to change it!
Mike Franken is a man of integrity. And he’s got a real shot at defeating Chuck. But this race could be as close as my first one was. And that other spineless fossil, Mitch McConnell, and his Super PAC buddies are going to drop millions to try to win it.
If Mike Franken is going to follow in my footsteps and become the next Senator Franken , he needs people like you to chip in to his campaign today:
I’m personally asking you to split $25 now (or whatever amount your heart desires) between Mike’s campaign and CommonGood to help him defeat Chuck Grassley this November and protect Democrats’ majority in the Senate [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgvafranken?refcode=20220916_CGVA_Franken]
Donate [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgvafranken?refcode=20220916_CGVA_Franken]
Control of the Senate is at stake – and our democracy is on the ballot.
On behalf of the entire Franken clan, thank you.
Al

This is a sponsored send hosted by CommonGood. CommonGood is dedicated to helping Democratic campaigns and organizations win critical races in Virginia and across the country.

| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

name: Andy Kim
subject: Where it all begins
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Andy Kim for Congress
body:
The best thing we can do as a society is invest in our children's future.

This is who we are. We are an America that doesn't leave anyone behind, that aspires to give every child the same opportunities, no matter who they are or where they come from. That's the America my parents envisioned for me when they immigrated to this country, it's the America I want for my boys, and it's at the heart of the work I do in Congress.

So let's talk about one place where it begins for so many of us: school.

The first years in school can be some of the trickiest, not only for kids, but for parents – especially folks working several jobs or difficult hours to keep food on the table.

This is where universal and free public pre-kindergarten programs are absolutely necessary. I'm talking about more than just a place where a child can spend time while their parents work; these programs provide structure, social skills, meals, a sense of community, and the building blocks for a lifetime of learning.

All too often, pre-K programs are exclusive and expensive, and only within reach for well-off families. That has to change. Every family deserves to have access to quality pre-K education, a place where their children can begin down a path that leads to a lifetime of curiosity, learning, and all the valuable skills and insights that come with it.

Congress can absolutely do something about that. We need to ensure that local school districts have the resources and support they need, and that education never feels out of reach for any family.

That's the promise we make to every family that calls our country home, one my parents dreamed of when they first came here, and one I'm going to fight every day to protect.

Andy

https://www.facebook.com/TNVoterProject [https://www.facebook.com/TNVoterProject]
September 17, 2022
Dr. Jason Martin was in Memphis this week to raise awareness around the pitiful treatment of rape victims under GOP leadership [https://dailymemphian.com/article/30982/memphis-tennessee-gubernatorial-candidate-jason-martin-faults-tbi-dna?fbclid=IwAR33oXGJpWs4jz6u_TkPKvy-4qaXRaNBdoGIfqM2qKSbzGmptviolwqqfaY] . He was in Memphis because it made national news when it was discovered that rape kits sit untested for nearly a year at the Tennessee Bureau of Investigation. The reason the TBI is not testing rape kits is simple. They just haven’t received the state funding they need to test in a timely matter. Sadly, this lapse means that some cases go unresolved. Some criminals avoid justice.
This is just one more piece of evidence that we need a fresh set of
eyes in our Governor’s office.
Dr. Jason Martin [https://martinfortn.com/] will make sure that sexual assault victims and their cases are taken more seriously than this. Dr. Martin has been clear: “Governor Bill Lee fails to take sexual assault seriously and underfunds current investigations. We sadly live in a state where you could be forced to have your rapist’s baby before your rape kit comes back from TBI’s crime lab. This is Governor Lee’s Tennessee.”
We need someone, like Dr. Jason Martin, who’ll speak up for sexual assault survivors.
JOIN TVP IN SUPPORT OF DR. JASON MARTIN FOR GOVERNOR [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tvpformartin]
And, by the way, we need someone, like Dr. Jason Martin, who isn’t afraid to debate his opponen [https://www.facebook.com/TheTNHoller/videos/1050078972360731] t on the important issues facing our state.
We’re getting behind Dr. Jason Martin for Governor [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tvpformartin] , along with a host of Democratic candidates, because it’s high time we turn things around in this state. We could use your help. Tennessee Voter Project Staff

disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY PEOPLE FOR PATTY MURRAY
body:
#
Peter,
My name is Dr. Kim Schrier. I'm a pediatrician, mother, and representative for Washington's 8th Congressional District. I'm reaching out today because I'm running for re-election in one of the most competitive districts in the country.
Control of the House majority hinges on WA-08 and election experts are calling my race a "toss up." In our primary election, votes in WA-08 were split almost exactly 50/50 – so this race is going to be close.
I'm running against an extreme, MAGA Republican, Matt Larkin. Larkin is an unapologetically anti-choice Republican who celebrated the end of _Roe v. Wade_ , said he "loves all the things" President Trump does, and even refused to say if Joe Biden's victory was legitimate. National Republicans and my opponent will do – and spend – whatever it takes to flip this seat red, so I need your support right away to win in November.
**[Will you split a donation of $5 or more right away between my campaign and Patty Murray's to help protect my seat and our Democratic majority in Congress?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50854341/367419359/-1071786050?refcode=pm_em_220917_1&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=18326&firstname=Peter&lastname=&addr1=&city=Cresco&state=PA&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYjQ1NWRkOC04YzM2LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FLfK-GcDgLo5fmGu1kIiX51tW5Vf435igZn5dNcuKZU=)**
I never thought I would run for political office, but that changed after the 2016 election. I watched Republicans in Congress stand in lockstep with a corrupt president on the wrong side of every issue near and dear to my heart – healthcare, environment, education, and children’s wellbeing. And then I saw my own representative vote to repeal the Affordable Care Act. That was the last straw for me, so I decided to run for Congress.
Thanks to the support of an amazing grassroots team, we flipped Washington's 8th District blue _for the first time ever in 2018_ and kept it blue in 2020 – even with Republican dark money groups spending millions of dollars to defeat me.
Since coming to Congress, I've helped pass legislation to lower the cost of prescription drugs, invest in our infrastructure, protect the environment, and so much more. And as the only pro-choice woman doctor in Congress, I will always fight to protect a woman’s right to choose. **I'm running for re-election to continue making progress for Washingtonians, and to protect the nation from extremist politicians, but I can't win without grassroots support.**
**[Split a donation between my campaign and Patty's to help keep us in Congress fighting for progress.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50854343/367419361/-1071786050?refcode=pm_em_220917_1&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=18326&firstname=Peter&lastname=&addr1=&city=Cresco&state=PA&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYjQ1NWRkOC04YzM2LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FLfK-GcDgLo5fmGu1kIiX51tW5Vf435igZn5dNcuKZU=)**

Kim Schrier

I grew up in Iowa. There's not a lot to do there, but that's where I honed my work ethic. I worked hard. I learned to fight. I gained that fighting spirit the old establishment GOP never had -- that's what makes me a part of the NEW RIGHT. I developed that backbone of steel - that "BDE" that President Trump and Governor Ron DeSantis have. And frankly, that we want all of our elected leaders to have. Someone even recently told me "Kari, you're going to be the DeSantis of the West." Other than being called "Trump in a Dress" -- which is my favorite compliment of all -- that is the greatest compliment you could pay me. **To me, that means that you know when you elect me, you 're going to get someone who fights for you every single day. ** We are going to be so effective in Arizona.
---
[**SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61312386:JxO3BDVCN:m:1:3253819041:4FAA21BD0668F76B40544A759DEFDEA0:r)
---
**Peter, I promise you this, as the governor of Arizona, I will be the biggest pain in the ass Joe Biden 's ever experienced. ** I will unite with conservatives across the country to protect Arizona from this out-of-control federal government. We will save our states and return the power to WE, THE PEOPLE, where it belongs. **_This is our moment to make it happen. _**
---
Make no mistake... My opponent would be a NIGHTMARE to the pro-freedom, pro-America agenda we want to implement. Here's what you should know about Katie Hobbs. ➡️ **_SHE WILL NOT DEFEND YOUR RIGHT TO BEAR ARMS!_** Katie has an F grade when it comes to protecting our Second Amendment rights. I don't know about you, but I feel that our Second Amendment is the most important amendment right now. _It 's the reason that we are still free. _ **➡️ _HER VOTING RECORD IS SHOCKING!_** She'll never talk about it, but 90% of the time when she was in our state legislature, she voted against small businesses. 90 percent! **➡️ _SHE FAILED TO SECURE OUR ELECTIONS._** Hobbs served as Secretary of State in 2020 in one of the most corrupt elections in American history. **➡️ _SHE IS A CONVICTED RACIST!_** Two separate juries unanimously convicted her of racial discrimination, and the taxpayers of Arizona are paying for her crimes! Almost $3 million as a payout for her court settlement because she did not pay Black employees the same as she paid white employees. _That is disgusting._
We cannot afford to let a radical lefty like Katie Hobbs turn Arizona into another California.**__**_[**Will you help me defeat her?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61312386:JxO3BDVCN:m:1:3253819041:4FAA21BD0668F76B40544A759DEFDEA0:r)_
---
Now, I don't care if you're with the Democrat Party, the Independent Party, the Republican Party, the Pizza Party, or the Pool Party - our policies are going to help every American. **_[We have to stand together and defeat the left so we can save America](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61312386:JxO3BDVCN:m:1:3253819041:4FAA21BD0668F76B40544A759DEFDEA0:r)_. ** I hope that you will chip in now to support my campaign for Governor of Arizona.**__**

Republican Senator Lindsey Graham introduced a bill earlier this week to ban abortions nationwide after 15 weeks. Graham said, "If we take back the House and Senate, I can assure you we'll have a vote on [this bill]." After the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade earlier this year, millions of women across the country lost access to abortion care. If this legislation passes it would mean that regardless of whether you live in a red or blue state, your rights to reproductive care are at risk. = Throughout his time as State Treasurer, Seth has fought to defend reproductive rights. Seth worked to pass the Reproductive Privacy Act, which codified Roe into Rhode Island law. And he supports the Equal Access to Abortion Act because a women's right to reproductive health care should not depend on her health insurance. Now, Seth is ready to continue this important fight in Congress. On the other hand, his Republican opponent, Allan Fung, opposed codifying Roe v. Wade in Rhode Island and was endorsed by RI Right to Life, a group that wants to make abortion illegal. body:
|

Friend, I'll be blunt: Right now we're at a turning point in our nation's history, with _Truthout_ reporting that _**"What Happens in 2022 Could Determine Whether Democratic Government Endures in [the] US."**_ The way I see it, we have two options to choose from:

**OPTION 1:**

Allow Trump’s election denying GOP allies to win races that will give them _control over the presidential election_ in 2024, potentially including the ability to _reject legitimate election results._

OR

subject: I will not stand silent

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-franken?refcode=220917 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-franken?refcode=220917]
Will you split a donation between Admiral Mike Franken's campaign and Seth Moulton today and do your part to flip Iowa from red to blue and protect our Democratic Senate majority? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-franken?refcode=220917]
Friend,
Well, that didn’t take long. Less than an hour after I was declared the Democratic nominee for Senate in Iowa, the attacks from Chuck Grassley began:
*
“The
most
liberal
nominee
in
Iowa
Senate
history”
*
“Radical”
*
“Socialist”
Gotta love it! Chuck Grassley doesn’t know what to say about me. He’s never faced an opponent like me before. I’m his political nightmare, so he’s just throwing cow pies at the wall and hoping something sticks.
Calling me “radical” is laughable when Chuck Grassley supports a complete ban on abortion and letting literally anyone buy an AR-15 without even a background check.
But there’s one attack that I absolutely won’t take lying down, and that’s Chuck Grassley attacking me for serving our country for 36 years in the U.S. Navy.
Grassley is already trying to say that because I enlisted in the military at age 19, because my deployments meant that my family had to move from state-to-state and country-to-country... that I’m not an Iowan anymore.
Chuck Grassley wants to pretend that I wasn’t raised in rural, northwest Iowa. He ignores the enormous sacrifices that my family – my wife and my kids – made to allow me to serve in the Navy.
Grassley’s attacks denigrate every servicemember and every military family that has to pack up, change schools, say goodbye to friends, spend holidays away from each other, and be absent from life’s big events like weddings and the birth of a child.
And if Chuck Grassley thinks that I will stand silent while he says that every Iowan who puts on our country’s uniform stops being an Iowan... he’s delusional.
These are the kinds of attacks I’m going to be up against. Nasty stuff from Chuck Grassley, Mitch McConnell, and the Fox ‘Entertainment’ News propaganda network.
There’s one reason why: The GOP is scared. They’ve seen the polls, and they know that if we defeat Grassley and turn Iowa blue this November, Democrats are guaranteed to maintain our Senate majority.
In order to fight back, we need to raise another $100,000 before midnight tomorrow, but the only way we’ll hit our goal and send Grassley packing is if grassroots donors like you give right now:
Please, can I count on you to split a donation of $25 or more right now between my campaign and Seth Moulton – every dollar you can afford – to help me defeat Chuck Grassley, turn Iowa blue, and protect our Democratic Senate majority? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-franken?refcode=220917]
These attacks against me are ridiculous, but we cannot let them go unanswered.
Thank you for being a crucial part of this phase of our campaign,
Mike Franken, U.S. Navy (ret.)

body:
Thank you for your support
Friend, I never thought I’d be drafting this email to you... But our worst fears have come true – Democrats are surging, the Red Wave is shrinking, and Beto O’Rourke is on the verge of pulling ahead. In every way, we’re getting crushed... People have said I should write my letter of resignation, because if Democrats win in 2022, they’ll throw me and every ULTRA-MAGA Republican in a jail cell. They insist that the government designed by our Founding Fathers, as expressed in the Constitution, is **flawed** and **outdated** --not adequate for the challenges of our time. Thomas Jefferson described _The Federalist Papers_ as "the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written." That means that defenders of the Constitution have no better help in understanding the principles of liberty underlying our Constitution than the words of the Founders themselves. **So, I 'd like to send you our entire 10-lesson course, "_The Federalist Papers_ ,"on DVD today with a donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.** _**" The Federalist Papers"**_ course comes in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or a small group. Peter,

I took executive action to protect the right to reproductive choice in New Mexico – as well as New Mexico doctors who perform abortions.

Michelle Lujan Grisham

subject: Economic gloom? Things could be worse, we could be Europe or China – update from your favorite think tank
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/leadershipacademy-8132612?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
|
Dear #VALUE!,

**First the Fed underestimated the risk of inflation.** US Treasury Secretary, Janet Yellen, admitted recently that she had misjudged the threat that rising prices posed.

**Now it seems that they overestimated how fast inflation would fall.** Figures out this week show that the consumer price index rose 8.3 percent over the past year – higher than expected even if the trend is down.
---
| [ ](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=c48cb062f4&e=5703353baa)
---
_Why is the economy underperforming? Edward Chancellor offers intriguing insights_
| The prospect of the Fed now having to go even further in raising interest rates has increased - and with it the risk of recession.

**The Fed seems to have a misplaced confidence in its ability to use monetary policy to engineer economic growth, perhaps because it has been doing so for so long.**

Ever since the era of the ‘Greenspan put’, the Fed has lowered rates to encourage growth. The problem is that cheap credit comes at a price.

**In his magnificent new book,_The Price of Time_ , Edward Chancellor shows how low interest rates cause all kinds of collateral harm to the economy and society itself. **I had the opportunity to interview him recently, from our Jackson studio, and you can watch our conversation in the video above.

>From poor productivity to stagnating real wages to inequality, low interest rates seem to be the source of a lot of America’s economic ills.

Interest rates in America are going to have to rise, although even that might not tame inflation quite as effectively as some assume. There is, Chancellor suggests, lots of malinvestment out there, with oodles of dollars invested in ventures that will never prove profitable. So-called ‘zombie’ companies are able to service their debts when interest rates are low, but will find it far harder when rates rise.

Cheap credit brought forward tomorrow’s consumption to today. But what happens when tomorrow comes?

**The economic outlook might look challenging for America, but things are far worse elsewhere. **

Europe has even higher inflation, a potentially existential energy crisis and a mountain of debt piled on the shoulders of a rapidly ageing population. Oh, and they also have a currency union, the Euro, that allows some states to spend, in effect, at everyone else’s expense.

For decades, progressive politicians in America have advocated making the US more like Europe, with higher taxes and spending, socialized healthcare and welfare.

**This winter not even Europe is going to want to be like Europe anymore. The European model is a perfect demonstration of how not to run a modern Western society.**

China’s debt and demographic problems are even worse. The average Chinese citizen is now older than the average American, they produce less and owe vast debts on a per capita basis. The section in Chancellor’s book about China is an eye opener.

Higher interest rates in America may at least unleash a bout of creative destruction. After reading Chancellor’s book, I don’t think that in Europe and China there will be anything creative about the destruction.

America remains, despite the best efforts of the current administration, a relatively low tax, lightly regulated economy. No matter how gloomy the immediate economic outlook, that means America will bounce back.

If only there was an administration that believed in free markets and liberty - the two secret ingredients of America's success.

---

Douglas Carswell

body:
Could you please take a few minutes to complete our campaign's general election priorities survey?
| | |
---
Peter,

I’m Trudy Busch Valentine: a nurse, mother, children’s advocate, proud fourth-generation Missourian, and, **now, your Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Missouri****.** I’ve spent my life giving back and helping others, and now I’m running to do the same thing in Washington. I hope you’ll take just a moment to read about what’s at stake and why I'm in this race.
As a young girl growing up in Missouri, I watched my parents live the American Dream. They always told me, “To whom much is given, much is expected.” That sense of obligation to help others is what drove me to choose a life of service.

It’s why I volunteered as a candy striper when I was only 13 years old. It’s what led me to attend nursing school, work in hospitals, and later, work for the Salvation Army.
It’s also why I’ve decided to run for U.S. Senate;** Missourians deserve a senator who will put politics aside, put people first, and work to make sure that everyone is able to live out the American Dream. Now, as we head into the general election, I need to hear from top Democratic supporters like you, Peter. **
[**So I'm asking a favor: Could you please take a few minutes to complete our campaign's general election priorities survey? Your feedback is essential to helping me understand where to focus our efforts so that we can develop a winning strategy for November.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50878827/367479935/-2043110283?email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100&code=jtk311-su-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZGY1MmQxNi1hODM2LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xKbaiW7LuGDHhREPoV2xih-lI8f2QDWnDBqgYVErNqE=&emci=0ad33eba-3435-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&emdi=fdf52d16-a836-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&ceid=4450063)

I've been fortunate in life. I’ve never had to fight to get the healthcare I need. I’ve never seen an eviction notice on my door. I’ve never worried about paying my electric bill.

But too many Missourians have.
These days, the American Dream seems to come with a price tag – and that price is way too high. That’s why I’m ready to help lower the cost of basic necessities. I’m ready to expand access to affordable healthcare. I’m ready to defend a person’s right to choose. And I’m ready to put an end to our state’s tragic opioid epidemic.
Peter, we’ve known for too long that Washington is broken, with leaders dividing rather than uniting us. Missourians know that we need more compassion and less politics. To truly solve problems, we need leadership that puts politics aside and puts people first – and that’s exactly what I’m ready to do as your next U.S. senator.
**But look: I believe leaders should talk less and listen more – and that’s why I’m reaching out to you as we kick off this campaign.[Your answers today will help guide the strategy to fix a broken Washington and rebuild our great state. I’d be so grateful for your input.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50878829/367479937/-2043110283?email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100&code=jtk311-su-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZGY1MmQxNi1hODM2LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xKbaiW7LuGDHhREPoV2xih-lI8f2QDWnDBqgYVErNqE=&emci=0ad33eba-3435-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&emdi=fdf52d16-a836-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&ceid=4450063)**
While working in the hospital, I cared for children, seniors, and people from all walks of life. It’s also where I learned the importance of quality healthcare. As a nurse, I believe that every person deserves access to the very best medical care, and as a parent, I believe that every person should have access to contraception and abortion care – full stop.
Now that the Supreme Court has overturned Roe v. Wade, we're in an uncertain and scary time. **We don’t know what will happen next, but here’s what I do know: You can count on me to work for the rights of ALL Missourians.**
But I can only run a winning campaign if grassroots input is at the center of our strategy. **[So, Peter, will you help start the general election strong by responding to our priorities survey? clean_body: Could you please take a few minutes to complete our campaign's general election priorities survey? | | | Peter, I’m Trudy Busch Valentine: a nurse, mother, children’s advocate, proud fourth-generation Missourian, and, now, your Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Missouri. I’ve spent my life giving back and helping others, and now I’m running to do the same thing in Washington. I hope you’ll take just a moment to read about what’s at stake and why I'm in this race. As a young girl growing up in Missouri, I watched my parents live the American Dream. They always told me, “To whom much is given, much is expected.” That sense of obligation to help others is what drove me to choose a life of service. It’s why I volunteered as a candy striper when I was only 13 years old. It’s what led me to attend nursing school, work in hospitals, and later, work for the Salvation Army. It’s also why I’ve decided to run for U.S. Senate; Missourians deserve a senator who will put politics aside, put people first, and work to make sure that everyone is able to live out the American Dream. Now, as we head into the general election, I need to hear from top Democratic supporters like you, Peter. | | I've been fortunate in life. I’ve never had to fight to get the healthcare I need. I’ve never seen an eviction notice on my door. I’ve never worried about paying my electric bill. But too many Missourians have. These days, the American Dream seems to come with a price tag – and that price is way too high. That’s why I’m ready to help lower the cost of basic necessities. I’m ready to expand access to affordable healthcare. I’m ready to defend a person’s right to choose. And I’m ready to put an end to our state’s tragic opioid epidemic. Peter, we’ve known for too long that Washington is broken, with leaders dividing rather than uniting us. Missourians know that we need more compassion and less politics. To truly solve problems, we need leadership that puts politics aside and puts people first – and that’s exactly what I’m ready to do as your next U.S. senator. But look: I believe leaders should talk less and listen more – and that’s why I’m reaching out to you as we kick off this campaign. While working in the hospital, I cared for children, seniors, and people from all walks of life. It’s also where I learned the importance of quality healthcare. As a nurse, I believe that every person deserves access to the very best medical care, and as a parent, I believe that every person should have access to contraception and abortion care – full stop. Now that the Supreme Court has overturned Roe v. Wade, we're in an uncertain and scary time. We don’t know what will happen next, but here’s what I do know: You can count on me to work for the rights of ALL Missourians. But I can only run a winning campaign if grassroots input is at the center of our strategy. | | Thanks for joining our campaign for a better Missouri, Trudy | This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Dear Peter,
This violence in our communities has to stop and we must work proactively to protect our communities. Our thoughts and prayers are with the families of victims of violent crime across our entire state.
**But as we heal together, prayers and thoughts are not enough.[We must take action. ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50849975/367402655/22228921?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82ODcxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmODVmOWRhNy04ODM2LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=OJSOjo2syptRTEU_uxBfHW2GWgqqbbgGgrQN-ko0SP4=)**
In the decade since the Tennessee GOP illegally gerrymandered the state to gain a Supermajority, violent crime in our state has increased by more than 10% while the United States as a whole saw a decline.
Why does the GOP Supermajority sit idly by as we continue to see a skyrocket of mass shootings? We’ve seen a 13% increase in gun violence this year alone.
Why does the GOP Supermajority sit idly by as victims of sexual assault wait 9 to 11 months for their rape kits to be tested? The House Democratic Caucus has laid out a plan to give the Tennessee Bureau of Investigations the full resources they need to test rape kits timely and efficiently, but the GOP refuses to act.
**Point blank, the GOP Supermajority is not concerned with preventing crimes in our communities - their focus is on what to do after our communities are already suffering. Enough is enough. We need a General Assembly who will pass legislation to stop crime before it even happens. We need to elect more Democrats.**
**[Join us in standing up to the GOP Supermajority, so we can work to end violence across Tennessee!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50849976/367402657/22228921?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82ODcxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmODVmOWRhNy04ODM2LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=OJSOjo2syptRTEU_uxBfHW2GWgqqbbgGgrQN-ko0SP4=)**
Thank you,

**Governor Hogan delivered a keynote address at the Jeju Forum for Peace and Prosperity in South Korea. This international forum aims to bring together world leaders to discuss how to advance the cause of peace and prosperity. Previous speakers to this global conference include President Bill Clinton, UN Secretary-General Ban Ki-Moon, and Soviet Premier Mikhail Gorbachev.** **Following are excerpts from the address:** **On the Future of Freedom and Democracy-** _“Today, we are once again at such a pivotal moment in world history. Russia has invaded a peaceful neighbor in Ukraine. North Korea and Iran are emerging nuclear powers and reckless aggressors. China threatens Taiwan and seeks to dominate Asia and the world. Many are concerned about whether the free world still has the will to lead._ _To those who again doubt the free world, I would say do not bet against freedom and democracy. People all across the world still yearn to live in freedom. President Zelensky and the brave people of Ukraine have reminded the world of the power of the human heart that yearns to be free. Australia’s stand for economic sovereignty shows us that power cannot be sustained on coercion alone. The historic success of America’s development and deployment of COVID-19 vaccines affirms that innovation and prosperity cannot be dictated by any centralized state.”_ **On Authoritarianism-** _“Yet, even as we remain confident in the values of the free world, we must not fail to recognize that we are at a fragile and dangerous moment in history._ _Authoritarianism is most dangerous when challenged and on the decline.”_ **On American Values-** _“We want leaders who can discuss and debate, with as much civility as passion. And with a view to persuade, not to intimidate. To encourage, not demonize or defeat._ _We believe that free and fair trade can be mutually beneficial. We want to work together with our allies for peace and prosperity. We still believe that everyone deserves a shot at their dreams._ _We still believe in a nation where an immigrant born on a chicken farm in Jeollanam-do province in Korea can grow up to become the very first Korean-born First Lady of any state in American history.”_

**New data released by Maryland’s Democratic Comptroller shows how Governor Hogan has achieved a remarkable turnaround of the state’s fiscal health in his tenure.** **In 2014, Governor Hogan inherited a $5.1 billion structural budget deficit after his predecessor raised taxes 43 consecutive times. Now, after eight years of pro-growth policies and $4.7 billion in tax cuts, Maryland will close the 2022 fiscal year with a record reserve fund of $4.4 billion and a revenue surplus of $2 billion in its general fund.** **While Washington’s big spending policies continue to produce crushing inflation on American families, Governor Hogan has restored fiscal discipline while growing the economy and investing in key priorities.**

Russia has invaded a peaceful neighbor in Ukraine. North Korea and Iran are emerging nuclear powers and reckless aggressors. China threatens Taiwan and seeks to dominate Asia and the world. Many are concerned about whether the free world still has the will to lead. To those who again doubt the free world, I would say do not bet against freedom and democracy. People all across the world still yearn to live in freedom. President Zelensky and the brave people of Ukraine have reminded the world of the power of the human heart that yearns to be free. Australia’s stand for economic sovereignty shows us that power cannot be sustained on coercion alone. The historic success of America’s development and deployment of COVID-19 vaccines affirms that innovation and prosperity cannot be dictated by any centralized state.” On Authoritarianism- “Yet, even as we remain confident in the values of the free world, we must not fail to recognize that we are at a fragile and dangerous moment in history. clean_body: | = | | I’ve got a rare 15 minutes free in my schedule today, folks, so I thought: Why not reach out personally and share why representing MI-11 in Congress is so important to me? I decided to run for Congress back in 2017 because I wanted to make a difference for our community and country. I knew it was a longshot in a historically red district like ours, but I know a thing or two about tough fights – and how to win them. That’s why no matter what skeptics said, I never gave up. I didn’t give up when I became the Chief of Staff to the U.S. auto task force under President Obama and was told we would never be able to save workers' jobs. But we saved two million jobs in the auto industry – 200,000 of which were here in Michigan. And I didn’t give up when I was told I wouldn’t be able to win in a historically red district as a Democrat. But I flipped MI-11 blue in 2018, becoming the first Democrat to do so in nearly 100 years. And this grassroots team fought back against the GOP to help me win re-election in 2020. We’re going to keep working to break down barriers that anti-voter bad actors have created to limit voter participation. Whether it’s building robust voter protection plans, filing our landmark _Fair Fight Action v. Raffensperger_ voting rights case, or making sure Black and brown voters have information on the power of their vote — it’s all been leading up to ensuring every eligible voter can make their voices heard at the ballot box. **And with so much at stake this election, it’s imperative that we come together and give every eligible voter the opportunity to cast their ballot.[_So please, can you chip in $20 or whatever you can to help power our efforts to protect the freedom to vote?_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50879682/367483595/2032965870?refcode=bsc_emm_ffa_20220917_f_earlyvote_v1s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNzk2ODdhNC1hYTM2LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=OHOMKe-yyBWUlxKeonA_KwHMgptYq34t6-xtOsAmqwE=)** In May, voters turned out in record numbers for dozens of races up and down the ballot in the Georgia Primary Election. With only in-person early voting and mail-in ballots, turnout was **up over 166%** from the 2018 primary, with **over 875,000 Georgians** casting their vote. This is not by chance. Our team has been laser-focused on dismantling systemic voter suppression to truly create a representative democracy. Increased voter turnout is a result of this. And we can get so much more done ahead of the start of early voting on October 17 if we keep working together to change the way our democracy is run — and who it works for. **This election will have consequences. Friend, I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z6ah71sphrligtbrfmbo1katakkp6reh9htaskoo_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37d1m65qbfctjmkrncst66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2uiq36srhm5gm2ctgmlge0s9ke5q6fdpleppmaob1m3j30ttmmkrr1dpjcphn0s37q9o74p1m62p6csjk65r61o5kckoe1d9hcjj6cphh6apm4o3imhj38p5jchjr1db5e8gq48bi4bh28or3cpgmcob0chge49fg)

| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ze9cfb7q9p9nbmjajhpmj0un7r44vrb5pbolfnko_rp22sh2s8i66or6c5j62o34c3h2bs "Johnson1")**_

Please, Friend, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

---
| |
* * *
A note from Ron Johnson: America is in peril. President Reagan warned that freedom is fragile, always one generation away from extinction. As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches: this is a fight for freedom. **This is not someone else 's fight, this is our fight, and it's a fight we absolutely must win.** As a grandpa, dad, and businessman, I refuse to lose our country to radicals and woke liberals with their socialist agenda. I refuse to jeopardize America's future. I know you feel the same.

_**[**Can I personally ask you to join me in this fight for Freedom, Friend?**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z53kfv01v6i5oncor89gtef0813nhtj57q7vp198_rp22sh2s8i66or6c5j62o34c3h2bs "Can I personally ask you to join me in this fight for Freedom, Friend?")**_

[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Derek,

September 19 will mark 50 days until Election Day. That’s why today, we’re
launching our 50 Days Fund — and we’ve set the ambitious goal to raise
$250,000 by Monday at midnight!

Hitting our goal in just a few short days will show everyone just how
strong and energized our team is. However, if we fall short, it will
signal to Brian Kemp, national Republicans and everyone else that our
momentum is slowing down in this final stretch.

We can hit our $250,000 goal, but we’re going to need all hands on deck to
reach it by September 19.

Derek. Will you help fill our
50 Days Fund with a $5 contribution now? This goal may seem
daunting, but if everyone reading this — including you — chips in now
we’ll hit it in just two short days.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/3233?refcode=sa_em_220917_B1_50day_S1_T1_HQ_SL&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1007&akid=8117%2E1862389%2EZ8PV7C ]DONATE

need to raise in order to train volunteers, invest in ads on every
platform, mobilize voters and everything else we need to do in the final
50 days of this campaign to elect Stacey Abrams.

You’ll hear more from us as we get closer to September 19th. But for now,
we want to leave you with this, a reminder of the people we are fighting
for:

We’re fighting for a single parent in Commerce
A woman seeking an abortion in Dublin
A small business owner in Decatur

A teacher in Quitman
And you.

Derek, Stacey
is in this race to create a stronger Georgia for everyone. And we’re
counting on grassroots
supporters like you
to make clear that we have what it takes to win, with just over 50 days
left to go.

Derek, let’s

Stacey Abrams HQ

I need to be upfront about the stakes of our must-win Senate race, Friend:
I am up against an opponent handpicked by Donald Trump.
I am up against a Senate GOP campaign arm that's already spent $80 million this year to flip the single seat they need to take back Senate control.

**If we lose this seat, it won 't just mean that another Trump-backed extremist is in the Senate. Peter,

My team did some digging and found that the U.S. Chamber of Commerce gave my opponent, Pelosi-backed Jahana Hayes, **a D rating.**

While she might not have received an **F** , **in my book -** **_she does._** Our small businesses have not been given a second glance since the COVID-19 pandemic and were left on the back burner before the pandemic even started!

Hayes voted for sky-high taxes, has done NOTHING to combat inflation, and voted for the 87,000 new IRS agents that will target our middle-class and small businesses. **She has even gone as far as to say that _“Democrats single-handedly saved the economy.”_ How more out of touch could she be!? We are legitimately in a recession!**

Running a small business is an American dream for most, but they have been abandoned and forced to close under her watch. [**Jahana Hayes should no longer be in Office - plain and simple. **](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=13d3e3bb9d574591b419a9c13b09b84a&_e=ptWePbZE7NTN89H5JTWaETMk7_7DmWDa1Cr4pQ28Gg5A22f6zzZ2Pqojr6BAHQpstJVfX1aAZ5yRZJNkW-gdxskucUvYIYMKQIvXSANRlp9vYvRUiy3rgcY91ZniIRSu2Swdtm8QvcrlPyvHeLxTq9ZPPyW8V7CTzlGGMbJtIqjZ02N-Zi2hqDlYGdpFRJ23Pb3x-xXiDs-ey1XjKcNGpRBSFMZzqTkqqJL0H_JY7oXekMZ6s1a3vCQFtdER6O9v--887Juxax5apuQcm-nlqvzfH1FvSjsa0m08CRckep0NggBzgTbTz8nMIAIpBEs5QSfNUswTHYzLhLKrDy4n8rQvhueGET7Lh4umRtkmZLljcUS-bIFY7kSAMhwX2rvZfBMPAL7Co8mPnx6tTbUPL-pkLCaerZu3bzE648MMzS2VyCgk3N8Ps1YunNx3SSm-0luD0IYRRzCdhO3hcnxPlw%3D%3D)

As you may already know, supporting small businesses is one of my main priorities if elected to Congress. **I know they are the backbone of our economy, yet they receive no support.**

I’ve been fortunate enough to meet with small business owners that were on the verge of closing up shop. I listened to the struggles that they had undergone and the financial hardships endured just to barely make even. **I run my own small business, so trust me, I understand the issues!**

I want every citizen to have the same opportunities I have been given to live their American dream. **That is why I am running for Congress.** I know that I am living proof of the American dream, and I can’t let it end with me. The better we organize, the better we train, the better we find meaningful ways to contribute our skills, time, and passion to do this work, the better prepared we are for the fights ahead. | | | Peter, The Trump administration — **and the dire threat it posed to both U.S. and International communities** — unleashed a tidal wave of progressive movement energy and grassroots activism that none of us had seen in years. The groundswell of support for organizations like ours, leading legislative efforts across the country to fight right-wing extremism, demanded the creation of new opportunities for eager supporters, contributors, and activists looking to take action. So we did just that, launching volunteer-led voter contact programs that played critical roles in both the 2018 Midterms and the 2020 General Election — expanding our margins in both the House and Senate, and ousting Donald Trump. **Today, more than 26,000 WFP supporters have completed volunteer shifts and are now part of the Working Families Activist Community.** But our work is nowhere near done. We're working to better understand the skills, experiences, passions, and creativity that drive our WFP Activist Community. **[Will you take five minutes to fill out our WFP Activist Census? clean_body: The better we organize, the better we train, the better we find meaningful ways to contribute our skills, time, and passion to do this work, the better prepared we are for the fights ahead. | | | Peter, The Trump administration — and the dire threat it posed to both U.S. and International communities — unleashed a tidal wave of progressive movement energy and grassroots activism that none of us had seen in years. The groundswell of support for organizations like ours, leading legislative efforts across the country to fight right-wing extremism, demanded the creation of new opportunities for eager supporters, contributors, and activists looking to take action. So we did just that, launching volunteer-led voter contact programs that played critical roles in both the 2018 Midterms and the 2020 General Election — expanding our margins in both the House and Senate, and ousting Donald Trump. Today, more than 26,000 WFP supporters have completed volunteer shifts and are now part of the Working Families Activist Community. But our work is nowhere near done. We're working to better understand the skills, experiences, passions, and creativity that drive our WFP Activist Community. This census is a short survey that lets us know more about you as an individual activist, volunteer, or party supporter. It’ll give us some insight on the best ways to communicate with you, which volunteer opportunities or events best match your interests and skills, and how to develop training programs in line with what WFP activists are yearning to learn. The better we organize, the better we train, the better we find meaningful ways to contribute our skills, time, and passion to do this work, the better prepared we are for the fights ahead. And with the 2022 Midterms soon approaching, now is the time to take stock of what we’ve learned from the past so that we can implement the best strategy to win in November. name: Conservatives Give
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=67727a25e1bc460dbe73b48a928d7839&_e=Ls2w7vtIwrJ935Cgft1J3MCS3y3yAOfwBiOdfz2Jl22cNXzrUfeO6_46U4O7XoQj_uSpB-6KaoVCJrEU5KqNwvkq0EvyExDoe-E-YRjT6PDwByGDDPjJfyWDQvBea7mIOcf0s6_7ObzZHXbrSqayXypMQSprwXVfLBHeiXBpOpgBVwxfIV2wP3HB5949NcRe_CcEJdWQZrNDENgQ5k694ZazL7-jMafEzdbX04kcwLv63aLGSBNLdjuH50kPtZIywvM-3NhB7iv7c5eZnlcgBDoubw0t8qRqTE8YN2hHdEB1-Fk0qsO9XFKWGOSDG3-LtsB5gBWGbd59VDOWvJY6qT15VkBZ7iJaJzOVq64FlwxCAvFbLZq55KrpNe9GThM2DosJaueYN5Tftc0HP9A41A%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled "The Second World Wars." Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict's diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. | | | Friend,

First, Joe Biden told voters, "you ain't black" if they were still deciding between voting for him or Donald Trump.

Then, a liberal MSNBC guest called Winsome Sears 'The Black Mouth Of White Supremacy' when she became the first woman elected to the office of Lt. Governor in Virginia as a Black Republican.

Now, the co-host of "The View," Sunny Hostin, recently said on air that she "doesn't understand black Republicans," and that a black Republican is "an oxymoron."

I've seen more than my share of vicious opposition from "liberals" who want to tear me down simply because my life story is a direct rebuke to everything they're constantly saying about how our nation is "irredeemably racist" and how the "deck is stacked against" people like me.

I am the first African American Republican to serve in the U.S. Senate since 1979. And I am the first African American EVER to represent South Carolina in the U.S. Senate.

Friend, Democrats' divisiveness only hurts our country, and it is deeply saddening to see.

**[I'm reaching out to you today because I know I can count on you to show the Democrats that the GOP is indeed the big tent party - and we won't let their divisiveness tear our nation down.](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=30610b871c86434abc4ae63b0461ba71&_e=_YI1b3yBPUo74G92OBD2Fubfo-bPyNg-C-8VlMMaD8-tY93NOjedytsbXnfTqUHvMplOe78xY-Di1NentmxyGxEFyePuNZ46hYdC8bOElfp4ikjaIeL3HDv2YUXJHbFqLxuuscXpSM3GdUMXV7nmXCG53rZtbeTyal9miUetB11JocJSofHXpjKbkMD0PDUYq0gEgsLJDHwyEZkDpGH0WDQPyP2cpv9jqvtY1eBJ9U2-bFc_8LMEfB3nRjMv8tsXxX_04oBj5VVj3WLYeYdIMQb9EWNvRPEEAa4C5cK3xiFrh-sUewHQHWmF-6YIp7x0WPa2gCuYSolq9g7zRhuowniQQRgNktQwgdNgFUUmXNnrXV3TQYVYrTCgzs9ik_nv5C-Fw4kyedDeSIUaNAlupRGqVJOzQ4VR5MzccVK5umZUeyuXQwIIPjpPUCs7nkVJ9fU5lvm_CDKemED4OYAaK8sPiv58SJGFcLxT6NE6Bhs%3D "I’m reaching out to you today because I know I can count on you to show the Democrats that the GOP is indeed the big tent party - and we won’t let their divisiveness tear our nation down.")**

Miguel is a community advocate who has organized for Medicare for All and marginalized groups — and we’re excited to have him as an ally in office! ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Our Revolution members are packing Congress with new progressive allies like Greg Casar (TX-35), Summer Lee (PA-12), Becca Balint (VT), and others. Now, we have to get them across the finish line in November! [ ]Can you chip in a donation to help mobilize millions of voters to defeat the far right and elect more progressives - there’s no time to waste. ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] So far this election season, Our Revolution Phonebank Force has made over 750,000 calls - and counting! We want to hit at least 1 MILLION dials through November. Our midterm fight is in full effect - and we need our folks to step up across the country to help us defeat the far right, flip senate seats, and elect more allies into power. [ ]SIGN UP FOR A CALL SHIFT ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] WE GOT M4A ON THE BALLOT IN WISCONSIN! Our Revolution and our state and local chapters are fighting for Medicare for All — even getting in on the ballot in rural counties! Our Wisconsin Revolution mobilized community members in rural Dunn County to urge county supervisors to ask voters themselves if they want a universal, nonprofit healthcare system. As reported in [ ]Common Dreams, a range of residents including Our Wisconsin Revolution Co-Chair Steve Carlson testified that our current for-profit system is leaving millions of rural Americans without access to care or in deep debt. The Dunn County Supervisors - who include Our Wisconsin Revolution staffer John Calabrese (D-14) and Our Wisconsin Revolution volunteer Monica Berrier (D-13) - agreed unanimously to include the question on the November 8 ballot. Now, Our Wisconsin Revolution Executive Director Andre Walton says they’re gearing up for the “Say Yes” campaign in Dunn County and working with activists in Washburn, Douglas, and Portage counties to place similar referenda on ballots in the spring. ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Our Revolution NYPAN joined the 2022 Labor Day Parade in NYC last week — collecting more than 130 signatures in support of the NY Health Act! “We expressed our solidarity with our labor family and shared how taking health insurance off the negotiating table will help unions fight for higher wages, and better conditions,” said Our Revolution Organizing Coordinator Anna-Marta Visky. ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] After years of grinding negotiations with the railroad monopoly bosses in pursuit of paid sick leave and less grueling scheduling, more than 100,000 union rail workers will decide whether to accept or reject a deal that came down on Thursday. Our Revolution Chair Larry Cohen told [ ]Bloomberg he believes the White House’s attention to the dispute and the railroad companies’ difficulty retaining employees mean workers will still have leverage even if the deal is approved. Larry, who’s the former president of the Communications Workers of America, said they’re likely to say, “we made some progress on our issues about our working life, and we’re getting a lot of money in exchange for the hardships of this job. And we want to show that we work with this government.” ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] NEW NINA TURNER SHOW! Our very own Nina Turner will be hosting a brand new show — and we will definitely be tuning in! A hell-raising humanitarian, Nina is on a quest to unite our movement and coalition to take on the corrupt forces that seek to keep the power from the people. [ ]CHECK OUT NINA’S NEW SHOW! ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] In [ ]The Nation this week, progressive DNC member and Our Revolution ally James Zogby laid out the fight ahead as we work to Ban Dark Money from Democratic Primaries. Last week, Judith Whitmer, chair of the Nevada Democratic Party, presented our resolution on behalf of our coalition of 33 DNC members — but the committee blocked it. “Our elections are not for sale. Every voice in our party deserves an equal say, and every vision deserves a free and fair chance. Our democracy is only as strong as the public’s faith in it. It’s up to our party to lead by example,” Judith said. Banning dark money is vital to the future of our democracy, we will not be defeated. “We will return at the DNC winter meeting with stronger support—more endorsements from DNC members, members of Congress, and Democrats nationwide,” Zogby writes. “Because we now know how the game is being played, we will work to ensure a debate and a vote on this critical issue.” “The stakes are too high for Democrats—and democracy—to let our party’s primaries turn into auctions won by the highest bidder,” he said. We see how dark money targets progressive candidates, and it must be stopped. ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Joe Manchin plans to hold the government funding hostage for a deal to fast-track fossil fuel projects and cut frontline community safeguards - and Our Revolution is leading the call for a progressive mutiny in Congress. A coalition of 72 US House Reps have signed onto a [ ]letter led by US Rep. Raul Grijalva - but we need more of our representatives in Congress to stand in opposition. Friend, it’s Fred Guttenberg.

My life changed forever on February 14, 2018, when my beautiful daughter, Jaime, was murdered in the Parkland High School shooting. My son listened to the bullets that killed his sister.

Because of what happened to my children, I have dedicated my life to the fight for gun violence prevention across the country – _because no parent should ever have to experience the grief that I feel every single day._

**But, due to the refusal of Republicans to enact common-sense gun safety, thousands more have been forced to live through the pain of losing a loved one to gun violence.**

Quite frankly: I’ve had enough.

Time and time again, Republican members of Congress have offered their “thoughts and prayers” to victims’ families, while simultaneously refusing to vote for legislation that will actually save lives in the future.

**María Elvira Salazar is no different.** Just this June, she voted _against_ “red flag” legislation that would decrease violence and mass shootings across the country. Why would she vote against lifesaving legislation for the nation that we already passed in Florida after the Parkland shooting and that we know is working to save lives?

**Friend, I’m writing to you today because Annette Taddeo will be the gun safety advocate we need in Congress.**

She’s taken on the NRA before, and I know she’ll do it again. As a mother of a public school child herself, Annette will do everything in her power to prevent weapons of war from entering American classrooms ever again.

[**It couldn’t be more clear that Annette will bring the change we need to Congress, but she can’t get to Washington without our help. clean_body: = Friend, it’s Fred Guttenberg. My life changed forever on February 14, 2018, when my beautiful daughter, Jaime, was murdered in the Parkland High School shooting. My son listened to the bullets that killed his sister. Because of what happened to my children, I have dedicated my life to the fight for gun violence prevention across the country – because no parent should ever have to experience the grief that I feel every single day. But, due to the refusal of Republicans to enact common-sense gun safety, thousands more have been forced to live through the pain of losing a loved one to gun violence. Quite frankly: I’ve had enough. Time and time again, Republican members of Congress have offered their “thoughts and prayers” to victims’ families, while simultaneously refusing to vote for legislation that will actually save lives in the future. María Elvira Salazar is no different. Just this June, she voted against “red flag” legislation that would decrease violence and mass shootings across the country. Why would she vote against lifesaving legislation for the nation that we already passed in Florida after the Parkland shooting and that we know is working to save lives? Friend, I’m writing to you today because Annette Taddeo will be the gun safety advocate we need in Congress. She’s taken on the NRA before, and I know she’ll do it again.
