name: Jocelyn Benson
subject: An update from me
disclaimer_text:
Paid for by
Jocelyn Benson for Secretary of State
body:
With Election Day right around the corner (55 days to be exact) I want to update you on the work I’ve been doing as Secretary of State and on the campaign trail. We’ve got an important month and a half ahead of us!

As Secretary of State, my primary goal between now and Election Day is to make this election as accessible, transparent, and secure as possible. That means looking at our success in 2020 and doing everything we can to build on it in 2022. With our modernized voter registration system, it’s easier than ever for Michiganders to go online to check their voter registration status, register to vote, request an absentee ballot, and then track their ballot in the mail. You can do all of this at Michigan.gov/vote.

My office has also been hard at work updating voter rolls and ensuring that voter fraud remains extremely rare. In 2020, election extremists came up with all sorts of crazy conspiracies about “dead voters,” but they have been debunked by the state Auditor General, the GOP- led state Senate Oversight Committee, the state Bureau of Elections and countless clerks and independent journalists. This year, we’re again working to ensure that our voter lists are as accurate as ever and have established a website that explains exactly how we do this in strict accordance with all relevant state and federal laws. You can check it out here [https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.michigan.gov/sos/elections/upcoming-election-information/voters/voter-cancellation-procedures&sa=D&source=docs&ust=1663344277977899&usg=AOvVaw3x8MDEur1lR_1BUQnrLte4] .
I’m running for re-election so I can continue serving the people of Michigan in this important office. Will you contribution to my re-election campaign today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/movefast?refcode=081622]
I’m also proud that more and more Michiganders are taking advantage of our online services and self-service stations available at many local grocery stores, fulfilling my promise to save you time and effort when accessing the services provided by my office. Meanwhile, office visits continue to take an average of just 20 minutes, which I’m sure is why our online resident ratings continue to average more than four out of five stars. The campaign trail is as exciting and inspiring as ever. It’s great to see so many supporters from across the state showing out and supporting our movement. I’ve always said that I was elected to do two things: improve Secretary of State services and protect the integrity of our elections. And when I meet voters, I’m consistently hearing great feedback about the work we’re doing on both fronts.
While it’s great to meet and hear from voters on the campaign trail, it’s impossible to shake every hand before Election Day. That’s why my team released our first official campaign television ad. While we started in Detroit and Grand Rapids, it will be expanding to other media markets in the coming days. It’s a great ad and delivers the message I want Michiganders to know. Simply put, we’re moving fast and we have the results to prove it. Check it out here! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=042722]
secure.actblue.com/donate/movefast?refcode=081622 [secure.actblue.com/donate/movefast?refcode=081622]Onward,
Jocelyn

Aside from that, he’s also a business owner, family man, and even a substitute teacher.He has the biggest heart and is ready to give his all to his district. **[If that sounds refreshing, chip in whatever you can today!](https://links.adamforcolorado.com/u/click?_t=7e272b1bd9c74d2e84d4e4fa6ac8f7de&_m=3b219dba120a46e495fb59e085fe11c3&_e=0TNTw2nE-EAe-uIgSjeaTzsHm_necUD-JogZGKljElZxp5RBxyLQM6RYxg0s5XNp7oh7FOAO5RO8k9oxdqWJ1l8K0I0RIu8onlIsc0bIMtWUfSc0oF5ugyIBBow9bTkfVU_fGlR1QCQJ7V06xHHrXiGGPzcAo0VvnogvU-8dqd_zdFxRTyKYNYKT7iE7O5xyobxoGM8aIyhgxi0RsVgTlIPZY3VD2g0kF1B31d-lrZ5OW8Z_m_mrM9XR1MMGK1Ry9vbRXjg0aHvNdknQmvzA0fqmWrZC7sTobdhPpJiikoCR4i5eWY7NuhJP0SLF9MNiGNGQ16a0v3rk99vNEec6zpxHLLfcZyFnUju2nei_C6M3j90hZxd4FG_4r-fcJIfbU-13CUhcswG5g6XearrWSG2s52eOmPITrtmp8BWKEBM%3D)** Once Adam is elected, there will be a great sigh of relief from Coloradans and Americans alike.Thank you for your support,
Katy\---------- Original Message ---------- Folks,How are you? I just wanted to check in and see how things are going.Things around here are pretty busy, but I’m loving it. We’ve been hitting the campaign trail hard, visiting the district, talking with voters, and meeting people where they are at. The most rewarding thing about running for office is connecting with the incredible people across Colorado’s 3rd.We are nearing the end of the third fundraising quarter, our last full fundraising quarter of this campaign cycle. After that, we have just a month left to defeat Lauren Boebert once and for all. **[Can you give me a quick fundraising boost?](https://links.adamforcolorado.com/u/click?_t=7e272b1bd9c74d2e84d4e4fa6ac8f7de&_m=3b219dba120a46e495fb59e085fe11c3&_e=0TNTw2nE-EAe-uIgSjeaTzsHm_necUD-JogZGKljElZxp5RBxyLQM6RYxg0s5XNp7oh7FOAO5RO8k9oxdqWJ1l8K0I0RIu8onlIsc0bIMtWUfSc0oF5ugyIBBow9bTkfVU_fGlR1QCQJ7V06xHHrXiGGPzcAo0VvnogvU-8dqd_zdFxRTyKYNYKT7iE7O5xyobxoGM8aIyhgxi0RsVgTlIPZY3VD2g0kF1B31d-lrZ5OW8Z_m_mrM9XR1MMGK1Ry9vbRXjg0aHvNdknQmvzA0Y2Is33Rb3xQI8Wz6QorUvok3C8HIno48YXc01kP3d_V6ZHLFovgGtt91Gk_o1IKm8yz0GB6IqjI324OfirL7ngcgISOD2frqOaMCgkoiwyQrUVlMmJJKE9T7ZoOMPXLlmTwPSbgcbEUZ88txZvelLQ%3D)** Lauren Boebert has been the biggest threat to our democracy, and she has simply lost sight of any values. She has no moral compass, is unethical, and even breaks from her own party. She doesn't care about you, me, or any person in CO-03 except for herself.Coloradans are frustrated, embarrassed, and tired of constantly dealing with Boebert’s inefficiency. I think it’s high time to change that. I can’t promise the world, but Colorado will always come first. Colorado people, Colorado energy, Colorado water, Colorado jobs. I will be there for you.We have 14 days left until the end of the quarter and just over 50 until Election Day, and I could use your help to outraise Lauren Boebert. **[Could you make a quick donation to my campaign today to give us a big end-of-quarter boost?](https://links.adamforcolorado.com/u/click?_t=7e272b1bd9c74d2e84d4e4fa6ac8f7de&_m=3b219dba120a46e495fb59e085fe11c3&_e=0TNTw2nE-EAe-uIgSjeaTzsHm_necUD-JogZGKljElZxp5RBxyLQM6RYxg0s5XNp7oh7FOAO5RO8k9oxdqWJ1l8K0I0RIu8onlIsc0bIMtWUfSc0oF5ugyIBBow9bTkfVU_fGlR1QCQJ7V06xHHrXiGGPzcAo0VvnogvU-8dqd_zdFxRTyKYNYKT7iE7O5xyobxoGM8aIyhgxi0RsVgTlIPZY3VD2g0kF1B31d-lrZ5OW8Z_m_mrM9XR1MMGK1Ry9vbRXjg0aHvNdknQmvzA0ddtTyenDlsFw1ZrnAswRj6rktY8J-nyrKseMjilfGpGI2jr_s-ePa3rnDnwC18jz6s2BnycO4oEXvEkpoBL25X1TRG1kV7T0RxmU3axl29Wen_BSLlMA2zmvwEIYWA2-RVB9-1RK9uepZ6PG44GmDA%3D)** I greatly appreciate your support and all you’ve done for me these past few months since our launch. Let’s go on and defeat Lauren Boebert.– Adam _Sent via iPhone_ **Follow Adam Online:**[](https://links.adamforcolorado.com/u/click?_t=7e272b1bd9c74d2e84d4e4fa6ac8f7de&_m=3b219dba120a46e495fb59e085fe11c3&_e=Rqqu2VDtpq8x-YT-DSJvvz3zGbR8PsT3YflIFfD_atlzJG6OdY2nczPLLbqGwGu6CLpUAJMLEbAEaWhe2X-WPCAEsR6tTKEjo7G0XqXbWK057TJ922B3AJVYd79OXGGlr2Trz6V2PFv-HlonGZ-df7OoXQgKamEq6aKzAG8AleSKMn0s3cT9tM33yrqlVcWEeiKHrYd_13Qci7nUXCSWKzwJem33nRdTFFlYRGDhnHE%3D) [](https://links.adamforcolorado.com/u/click?_t=7e272b1bd9c74d2e84d4e4fa6ac8f7de&_m=3b219dba120a46e495fb59e085fe11c3&_e=Rqqu2VDtpq8x-YT-DSJvv3i6Gx9wxgq6GzeVttEIn7O3moYoXW_jMMTtoIUQRaxqO_wt5XjmKFPhz35-KbqUfbMyYfGAEMq3rBh83x3foaCRhOvVEbrrm2e5bvSf9Vjd2DAsvCjYX_tzeVhJ4xhHOx0owuthhrTnPAt40UV7A1ODnDIbz5DmfN8p-SfVOrF4xuLq-vjI3lL9uiNqGLaZWA%3D%3D) **[**UNSUBSCRIBE**](https://links.adamforcolorado.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=7e272b1bd9c74d2e84d4e4fa6ac8f7de&_s=3b219dba120a46e495fb59e085fe11c3&_t=Pk0BmZTV0Ry_IpdNQJPcmZPUrJ89qpVhXc-OlJwIFKYt2wujJNcXS9MzTwjCP6PmxFMd6tLTozGC_sVtbLXsmfkv_cQbqyXWtMIPq3Dh044%3D)** Paid for by Adam for Colorado

| | | | | _Hi! Cliff here, and we have a special guest who'd like to speak with you! You probably saw him in a viral clip just the other day, explaining to a clearly flummoxed Republican on CNN that two Supreme Court seats were stolen by Mitch McConnell & Donald Trump, and therefore this Court is illegitimate. _ _So, as they say in the business Al used to be in, Senator Franken, take it away!......._ __ Dear Person Who Still Opens My Email, I hardly ever ask anything of you. Unless you’re also on my other list of people who I constantly ask to contribute to something I don’t think I can legally mention here. (Though it’s a really good thing.) **[I want you to give to Josh Riley’s campaign for the open House in seat in NY’s 19th district. And to Blue Amp Action too.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1934d36e-3c2e-4e32-bbbf-6e0c9914c2ca/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**

| Josh was my Judiciary Committee counsel, and I cannot say enough good things about him. But here’s some. Josh grew up in the district in a working-class neighborhood of Endicott, NY. After graduating from Harvard Law School, Josh moved to Florida to work on a landmark civil rights lawsuit representing kids from low-income families who were having difficulty accessing the healthcare services they needed. Josh really, really cares about all the stuff I care about. Josh is the hardest worker I know. Together we passed bills expanding rights for survivors of domestic abuse and providing new funding for addiction treatment and mental health programs. We also made a lot of Republican witnesses look very bad. Josh is my friend. And finally, this open seat is considered one of the most competitive in the nation. **[Control of the House is up for grabs. Please help Josh win this one for all of us.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T45de7a29-23a9-48a3-b283-d7529f3857a9/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** This is important. To me. And to our nation. | | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

Tim Scott believes in our country and wants to create better opportunities for the next generation, and it begins in the states.

If it weren't for unwavering supporters like you, Peter, Tim's fight would not be possible, but we've got to continue his strides in order to reclaim the country we know and love. Will you join Tim Scott today to help fight for America?

---

\---------- Forwarded message \---------
Subject: An oxymoron
From: Tim Scott
To: <_**[dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61315282:6cWY8iVrN:m:1:3317145305:1F3BDA06B85E8C4084C1CFB01719B4C4:r)**_ >

Peter,

First, Joe Biden told voters, "you ain't black" if they were still deciding between voting for him or Donald Trump.

Then, a liberal MSNBC guest called Winsome Sears 'The Black Mouth Of White Supremacy' when she became the first woman elected to the office of Lt. Governor in Virginia as a Black Republican.

Now, the co-host of "The View," Sunny Hostin, said on air that she "doesn't understand black Republicans," and that a black Republican is "an oxymoron."

I've seen more than my share of vicious opposition from "liberals" who want to tear me down simply because my life story is a direct rebuke to everything they're constantly saying about how our nation is "irredeemably racist" and how the "deck is stacked against" people like me.

I am the first African American Republican to serve in the U.S. Senate since 1979. And I am the first African American EVER to represent South Carolina in the U.S. Senate.

Peter, Democrats' divisiveness only hurts our country, and it is deeply saddening to see.

**[I'm reaching out to you today because I know I can count on you to show the Democrats that the GOP is indeed the big tent party - and we won't let their divisiveness tear our nation down.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61315281:6cWY8iVrN:m:1:3317145305:1F3BDA06B85E8C4084C1CFB01719B4C4:r "I’m
reaching out to you today because I know I can count on you to show the Democrats that the GOP is indeed the big tent party - and we won’t let
their divisiveness tear our nation down.")**

As a Black man from South Carolina who was raised by a single mom who routinely worked double shifts to provide for my brother and me, I will always be grateful for the opportunities our nation has provided me and my family.

And I will defend those opportunities for your family and for the next generation. **[That's why I am asking that you join me and support State GOP Leaders that are upholding the values that make our country Great.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61315281:6cWY8iVrN:m:1:3317145305:1F3BDA06B85E8C4084C1CFB01719B4C4:r "That’s why I am asking that you join me and support State GOP Leaders that are upholding
the values that make our country Great.")**

---
Your support today is crucial to help more State Republicans stand up against Joe Biden's radical administration and protect the American Dream before it's permanently destroyed by open borders and Socialism.

Today is my husband Chuck's birthday! I am blessed to have Chuck by my side and I cherish every day we've spent together.

Chuck means the world to me, and I know the best birthday present he could ask for is love and support from not only me, but from all of his wonderful supporters across Iowa and our country.

**[So -- I really want to surprise him this year and show him just how much support he has!](http://links.grassleyworks.com/u/click?_t=65a7ce1d347445428d0d4f22dfbcf47b&_m=24ff9e4a3f294c95a6c0e2a32aa76ff1&_e=3HdbOaN3XshKX_w_gqdHjXux-36JXs0VweYCKZ8rnd-WlijFDKqYD1QcwlXuN1JzNeQdhm3-5OoXFRiHX9lngBNg7pg_HwP1sJz-PrabNOQTTFW_Dt61GV5IKJoVCaBCpmHgM0VIZ8jakFo3uhXaWMW_r6CWRhjUdjv71TYDCxlthmtgoHdVo3GN5x4J0xuGpHajxLjUVao_k-Ch0fuAfEfQZriFivF-cDzXFz29g3f6Z86hiJN88zVr3_obQek6_fkM0BBI_eo6Bb57VGbwgujKk7UNpf46WpjDSV_o_SGZ1Jv3uQwZZz8bnfGCmTbFgpqjrqd4r_QMqM54JPaJ5kFW8VYaFxQweBxPI4ArAlzf0eURJHRhJEH2k15ok4QDj20_e-27aT6v_ansHFeYxX7_sZUOOGEiIEZ8G2TFl1OveDNhA-OwwLc20TGT3nqJrIz5Mb13uI7GsyLYbHM4xQ%3D%3D)**

Friend, I would like to share a little bit of my family’s story and why I’m running to be the first Latina to ever represent Oregon in Congress. I hope you’ll take a moment to read it and then chip in to my campaign and help me make history. Thursday marked the start of Hispanic Heritage Month. From September 15 to October 15, we celebrate the unique contributions and culture of our communities and reflect on just how important they are to the fabric of the United States. As a Latina, I reflect daily on the contributions that the Latino community has made to our country. **And I know that millions of people in this country share my story – and my pride. Right now, I want to share the story of my father – a proud Latino man who inspires me every day.** Like many who made the harrowing journey before and after, my father immigrated from Mexico to the United States. Upon his arrival, he worked in the fields picking cotton and tomatoes in the Rio Grande Valley, joining millions of other migrants who sustain our country's agriculture industry. Later in life, he joined the military, and after serving two tours in Vietnam, he earned his U.S. citizenship. After that, he spent three decades as a police officer. Our stories are vast and varied, and no two are ever exactly alike. But in hearing each other's stories, we can sense the familiar. My immigrant father was a field worker, soldier, and police officer, but I know that his story resonates with doctors, teachers, and Members of Congress. I believe the best way we can celebrate Hispanic Heritage month is by uplifting these stories and voices from the Latino community. Today, I’m running to be the first Latina to represent Oregon in Congress. I’ll fight to protect our community and the issues we care about. **But I need your help to get there.** I’m polling neck-and-neck with my opponent, and experts agree it’s going to be a close race. **[So, I have to ask: Can you please make a contribution to my people-powered campaign and help elect the first Latina to represent Oregon in Congress?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50882556/367494486/1236068552?refcode=em_eng_2022.09.17_b1_AS_all-nd&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlOTJhODhhOS1iMzM2LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=caVC0m4q9gSNRlmJwHe7hVJSTrzC3tOUzDVV1Oi_KPk=)** __If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ _ | _[$5 »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50882557/367494487/1236068552?express_lane=true&amount=5&refcode=em_eng_2022.09.17_b1_AS_all-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlOTJhODhhOS1iMzM2LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=caVC0m4q9gSNRlmJwHe7hVJSTrzC3tOUzDVV1Oi_KPk=)_ | _[$10 »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50882558/367494488/1236068552?express_lane=true&amount=10&refcode=em_eng_2022.09.17_b1_AS_all-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlOTJhODhhOS1iMzM2LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=caVC0m4q9gSNRlmJwHe7hVJSTrzC3tOUzDVV1Oi_KPk=)_

I hope you’ll take a moment to read it and then chip in to my campaign and help me make history. Thursday marked the start of Hispanic Heritage Month. From September 15 to October 15, we celebrate the unique contributions and culture of our communities and reflect on just how important they are to the fabric of the United States. As a Latina, I reflect daily on the contributions that the Latino community has made to our country. And I know that millions of people in this country share my story – and my pride. Right now, I want to share the story of my father – a proud Latino man who inspires me every day. Like many who made the harrowing journey before and after, my father immigrated from Mexico to the United States. Upon his arrival, he worked in the fields picking cotton and tomatoes in the Rio Grande Valley, joining millions of other migrants who sustain our country's agriculture industry. Later in life, he joined the military, and after serving two tours in Vietnam, he earned his U.S. citizenship. After that, he spent three decades as a police officer. Our stories are vast and varied, and no two are ever exactly alike. But in hearing each other's stories, we can sense the familiar. My immigrant father was a field worker, soldier, and police officer, but I know that his story resonates with doctors, teachers, and Members of Congress. I believe the best way we can celebrate Hispanic Heritage month is by uplifting these stories and voices from the Latino community. Today, I’m running to be the first Latina to represent Oregon in Congress. I’ll fight to protect our community and the issues we care about. But I need your help to get there. As the son of hardworking farmworkers, I was up against all odds to become a United States Congressman. My family lived in a small trailer in rural California. My brother and I shared a bed that in the daytime converted into a kitchen table. Eventually, with the help of my family and my community, I went to UCLA and eventually to Harvard Medical School. I can’t imagine where I would be without my community behind me. That’s the reason I have dedicated my life to service. First as a doctor and now as a Congressman representing Coachella Valley. But the GOP is working overtime to unseat me. | | | | | | | Republicans put tax cuts for the 1% above education and health care. body:
|
#
Hey there — I noticed you haven’t been opening these emails lately. Look, I get it. They can get pretty overwhelming. But I hope you’ll give me just a moment to explain why they’re so important. I’m not your typical politician. For years, I was a geologist. Then, I took a chance and opened a brewpub in downtown Denver. I wandered into politics because I believed I could make a difference in people’s lives. I’ve never quit believing that — and thanks to this grassroots team, we’ve built an incredible movement that fights for progress every single day. I want you to know that I wholeheartedly respect the trust you have placed in me, and I’m deeply committed to making Washington work for everyone. And that includes you. subject: WA 🤝 NC

body:
#

Cheri said I could reach out to you all because she and I – while being from opposite ends of the country – are in pretty similar situations right now.
We are both in single-digit races against Republicans who not only have expressed doubts about the 2020 election – but would help Senate Republicans pass a national abortion ban if given the chance.
[**With so much at stake, Cheri and I need your help to fight back and elect a pro-choice Senate majority in November. Will you split $5 or whatever you can between our campaigns now?**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-pm-split.0x18G1&refcode=em220917-3-MA&t=1&akid=1758%2E357359%2E_efm0G)
Republicans are emboldened now more than ever to make abortion illegal in every single state. We need a pro-choice Senate majority to fight back – and we need leaders like Cheri who will fight to protect women’s reproductive rights each and every day.

Patty Murray

clean_body: This competitive House seat could be a big win for our shared values. | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Hi! Cliff here, and we have a special guest who'd like to speak with you! You probably saw him in a viral clip just the other day, explaining to a clearly flummoxed Republican on CNN that two Supreme Court seats were stolen by Mitch McConnell & Donald Trump, and therefore this Court is illegitimate. So, as they say in the business Al used to be in, Senator Franken, take it away!....... Dear Person Who Still Opens My Email, I hardly ever ask anything of you. Unless you’re also on my other list of people who I constantly ask to contribute to something I don’t think I can legally mention here. (Though it’s a really good thing.) | | | | | | | | Josh was my Judiciary Committee counsel, and I cannot say enough good things about him. But here’s some. Josh grew up in the district in a working-class neighborhood of Endicott, NY. After graduating from Harvard Law School, Josh moved to Florida to work on a landmark civil rights lawsuit representing kids from low-income families who were having difficulty accessing the healthcare services they needed. Josh really, really cares about all the stuff I care about. Josh is the hardest worker I know. Together we passed bills expanding rights for survivors of domestic abuse and providing new funding for addiction treatment and mental health programs. We also made a lot of Republican witnesses look very bad. Josh is my friend. And finally, this open seat is considered one of the most competitive in the nation. This is important. To me. And to our nation. Thanks, Al P.S. In my other letters, I always end with a P.S. that’s just an excuse for another ask. Josh is now officially the Democratic nominee in NY-19. | September 17, 2022

Dear Friend,

21 years may have passed, but I will never forget this day. It shaped and changed the trajectory of so many lives. I swore to support and defend the constitution two months later, starting my military service. There were 2977 lives lost that day in the 9/11 Terrorist attack.

Thank you to our first responders and military still keeping watch. You are in my prayers. God Bless America.

Sincerely,

Michael Maher

Friend,

I want to tell you an important story today, but before I do: [**Would you consider donating to my campaign for U.S. Senate?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50886432/367515226/-1315874399?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4407-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZmVmNzkxNy1kNDM2LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-eh5L4JGL_2NZk-quBsKayPLheF-eaJMn3HkcnU2fkk=) As a young girl, I could never have imagined that I'd become a congresswoman and one day run for U.S. Senate, but my parents believed in me and did everything they could to ensure I had a bright future. I'd be so honored to have your support, too.
**Now, let me tell you a story:** I remember in seventh grade, my class was going on a big trip to Washington, D.C. My dad, a janitor who worked seven days a week to make ends meet for our family, asked for an advance to pay for my plane ticket. I'm still amazed today he could find the money – and I'm touched that he sacrificed so much for me.
That first trip to Washington, D.C., made a major impact on me. I stood at the feet of Lincoln's statue in the Lincoln Memorial, gazing up at this giant of American history. I walked through the Library of Congress with wide eyes. I looked at the U.S. Capitol in awe, totally unaware that one day I'd have the opportunity to work in that very building.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50886433/367515227/-1315874399?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4407-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZmVmNzkxNy1kNDM2LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-eh5L4JGL_2NZk-quBsKayPLheF-eaJMn3HkcnU2fkk=)
If my parents could see me today, they would be so proud of everything I've been able to accomplish. I truly believe that only in America can a little Black girl growing up in the South in the 1960s have such an amazing story of opportunity.
But the truth is, my story is a rare one. For so many working families like mine, the American dream is simply out of reach. That's why I'm running for U.S. Senate to expand my story of opportunity to more Americans – by reducing student debt, raising the minimum wage, expanding access to child care and cutting health care costs.
If you're with me, I need your support right now. I'm neck and neck with Marco Rubio in this close race. If we flip Florida blue, Democrats could expand our Senate majority and pass our agenda, so I have to ask: **[Will you donate $5 right now to help me surge ahead, win this race and provide more opportunities for working families?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50886434/367515228/-1315874399?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4407-fr-nd&recurring=0&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZmVmNzkxNy1kNDM2LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-eh5L4JGL_2NZk-quBsKayPLheF-eaJMn3HkcnU2fkk=)**

Are they no longer New Yorkers either? Is she calling on all of them to just get on a bus and leave the state as well?

**_New Yorkers are ALREADY coming here to the Sunshine State in droves - and it's because of terrible leadership like HER'S!_**

Folks are fleeing a place where politicians like Hochul attack the wallets, safety, freedom, and kids' education of the very people she is supposed to represent.

And they're headed to places like my home state of Florida - **the #1 state in the entire nation for economic freedom where we don 't give in to the Radical Left's narratives!**

name: Nikki Haley
subject: Showing up is the hardest part
body:
| | |
---
Friend,
---
Pennsylvania. Atlanta. Knoxville. Illinois. Texas. ** ** I’ve logged thousands of miles over the past few weeks, doing my part to help Republican candidates get elected. So when I woke up the other day and faced the prospect of going to the gym in my Knoxville hotel, I thought to myself...** **_Ugh. _** **_Do I really want to?_**
They say showing up is the hardest part, and that’s true.** As I made my way to the gym, I thought of all the other things I could be doing (sleep was at the top of my list!). But I pushed those voices away. I cranked up some Jimmie Allen tunes and forced myself onto the treadmill.** **
---
[](https://links.standforamericanow.com/u/click?_t=d85fab909a98477596691a746a1de4c5&_m=c2e2360e5a9c4938b85843af201c2a7a&_e=uFS2Xippi6AVty3oYi1VV71bX_MP6_XFLjMcNSHlh9e2zFhS4wapU8b6k_MR2sIJ_-q7H6c7MyBBRmOEe8Ka2_rlKHaNtaF44XIniBqxx9wIOV8ti9I-6qx3AGr00P-HThv8WLSe1TFjkly-5_QAG2NHm0Saa12-XEsBohm-_3cj1p1KWXJIG1GYcbX69MMMBzgjNTxEtgONzhT5vbw7g6I-Z3OeqQb6BV4Xi4CQcAI%3D)
---
Boy, was I glad I did. I felt energized. I felt ready to tackle the world. The next two months are going to be exciting but exhausting. We have campaign events all over the country, stretching from New Hampshire to California. I may not be able to run as much as I usually do, but I will keep showing up and keep fighting. Because that’s the most important part. As we get down to the wire, I hope you’ll keep showing up, too. Showing up for our campaign fights, showing up for the things you’re passionate about, showing up for life. Even on rainy, humid days when it’s tempting to go back to sleep, let’s keep showing up and fighting for the things that matter most. Are you with me? My very best,

---
---
Nikki
---
| | |
---
**NIKKI IS COMING TO A CITY NEAR YOU!**

**Exclusive Message from Nikki Haley** When I was growing up, smart, strong, and unconventional women were discouraged. When I ran for office, the South Carolina legislature was dominated by a Good Old Boys Club and my opponent thought that women didn’t belong in politics. People thought I was too brown...too female...too young...too conservative...too principled... Well, I said: Too bad! ** ** I was inspired by great women who broke barriers and defied expectations, women like Margaret Thatcher and Jeane Kirkpatrick.
